title: Add Hestia error review and lineage-based scope guard counting
summary: Add an error review to Hestia that groups introspections by cause/class, queues one urgent root-cause request when a cause repeats across two or more distinct jobs without an open or landed request citing it, and shows repeated causes in athena status. Make the scope guard count attempts per line of work (previous_job and request text lineage). Audience: the operator (Sri) who catches repeats by hand today.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check queued requests and status output.
Docs and changelog written for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Grouping key is the introspection cause plus class, with the class registry or Jev's class answer resolving the class.
The error review runs right after an introspection is recorded.
The scope guard already has line grouping (group_lines, line_attempts); the work is to ensure counting follows previous_job and request text lineage, and to test it.
No athena.toml or workflow change is needed.

acceptance_criteria.text: Test (cargo test): two introspections with the same cause on different jobs queue exactly one urgent root-cause request citing both introspection ids via the shared steward request builder; a third introspection with that cause does not queue another while that request is open or landed.
Test (cargo test): a single-job repeat, or causes already cited by an open or landed request, queue nothing.
Test (cargo test): athena status output lists each open repeated cause with its count and the request addressing it.
Test (cargo test): the scope guard counts a retry (previous_job) and a re-ask of the same request text as one line of work and pauses at its threshold, not per job id.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy with -D warnings, and cargo test all pass.
CHANGELOG.md has an entry and docs/design/hestia.md describes the error review (grouping key, trigger, dedupe, status display).

out_of_scope: Changing how introspections are written beyond what grouping needs
departures: Larger than reference: touches four code modules plus design doc, with several tests.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time from repeated failures (four planning-cap stops, five brde attempts) and thrash caught late by hand.
hard_reason: Touches Hestia's automatic request queuing and the scope guard that pauses other jobs.
